#include "dispatcher.hpp"

#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

namespace beam {

__global__ void dispatcher_spin_kernel(std::uint32_t iterations, std::uint32_t salt, std::uint32_t* sink) {
    std::uint32_t x = threadIdx.x + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + salt;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < iterations; ++i) {
        x = x * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
    }
    sink[blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x] = x;
}

DispatcherOverlapResult dispatcher_overlap_smoke_cuda(std::uint32_t spin_iterations) {
    NvtxRange range("Dispatcher_real_cuda_streams_overlap_smoke");
    cudaStream_t streams[5]{};
    cudaEvent_t start{};
    cudaEvent_t stop{};
    std::uint32_t* sink = nullptr;
    cudaMalloc(&sink, 5 * 256 * sizeof(std::uint32_t));
    cudaEventCreate(&start);
    cudaEventCreate(&stop);
    for (auto& stream : streams) {
        cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking);
    }
    cudaEventRecord(start, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        dispatcher_spin_kernel<<<1, 256, 0, streams[i]>>>(spin_iterations, i + 1, sink + i * 256);
    }
    for (auto stream : streams) {
        cudaStreamSynchronize(stream);
    }
    cudaEventRecord(stop, nullptr);
    cudaEventSynchronize(stop);
    float elapsed = 0.0f;
    cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsed, start, stop);
    for (auto stream : streams) {
        cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
    }
    cudaEventDestroy(start);
    cudaEventDestroy(stop);
    cudaFree(sink);
    return DispatcherOverlapResult{elapsed, elapsed * 5.0f};
}

} // namespace beam

__global__ void stream1_score_contract_kernel(
    const State128* current_frontier_states,
    const std::uint64_t* parent_base,

    std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    std::uint32_t ring,
    std::uint32_t ring_slot,
    std::uint32_t ring_slot_count,
    std::uint32_t b_micro) {
    const std::uint32_t candidate = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    const std::uint32_t total = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    if (candidate >= total) {

    }
    const std::uint32_t parent_local = candidate / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    const std::uint32_t move = candidate % static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    if (parent_local >= count[ring * ring_slot_count + ring_slot]) {
        return;
    }

    const std::uint64_t parent_idx = parent_base[ring * ring_slot_count + ring_slot] + parent_local;
    const State128 state = current_frontier_states[parent_idx];
    std::uint32_t accum = 0;

    const std::uint32_t score_key = accum % (SCORE_MAX_KEY + 1U);
    const std::uint64_t offset =
        (((static_cast<std::uint64_t>(ring) * ring_slot_count + ring_slot) * b_micro + parent_local) * MOVE_COUNT) + move;
    score_ring[offset] = score_key;
}

#include "stream3.hpp"

#include "config.hpp"
#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

namespace beam {

__global__ void stream3_pack_threshold_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t candidates_per_slot = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < stream3_batch_candidates; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t local_i = i % candidates_per_slot;
        const std::uint32_t parent_local = local_i / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
        if (parent_local >= b_micro) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t score_key = score_ring[i];
        if (score_key > current_threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        compact_key[out] = hash_ring[i];
        compact_val[out] = (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(score_key) << 32) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i);
        ++out;
    }
    *compact_count = out;
}

void stream3_pack_threshold_cuda(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    const std::uint64_t*,
    const std::uint32_t*,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream3_threshold_compact_launch");
    const dim3 block(1);
    const dim3 grid(1);
    stream3_pack_threshold_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        score_ring,
        hash_ring,
        compact_key,
        compact_val,
        compact_count,
        current_threshold,
        b_micro,
        stream3_batch_candidates);
}

} // namespace beam

#include "stream4.hpp"

#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <stdexcept>

namespace beam {

__device__ bool hash_equal_device(Hash128 a, Hash128 b) {
    return a.lo == b.lo && a.hi == b.hi;
}

__device__ bool candidate_better_device(CandidateMeta a, CandidateMeta b) {
    if (a.score_key != b.score_key) {
        return a.score_key < b.score_key;
    }
    if (a.parent_idx != b.parent_idx) {
        return a.parent_idx < b.parent_idx;
    }
    return a.route_packed < b.route_packed;
}

__device__ std::uint32_t stream4_slot_device(Hash128 hash, std::uint32_t capacity) {
    const std::uint64_t mixed = hash.hi ^ (hash.lo * 11400714819323198485ull);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed % capacity);
}

__global__ void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        table_state[i] = 0;
    }
    *output_count = 0;
    *overflow_flag = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < input_count; ++i) {
        const CandidateMeta candidate = input[i];
        if (candidate.score_key > threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t start = stream4_slot_device(candidate.hash, capacity);
        bool inserted = false;
        for (std::uint32_t probe = 0; probe < capacity; ++probe) {
            const std::uint32_t slot = (start + probe) % capacity;
            const std::uint32_t state = table_state[slot];
            if (state == 0) {
                table_keys[slot] = candidate.hash;
                table_values[slot] = candidate;
                table_state[slot] = 1;
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
            if (hash_equal_device(table_keys[slot], candidate.hash)) {
                if (candidate_better_device(candidate, table_values[slot])) {
                    table_values[slot] = candidate;
                }
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!inserted) {
            *overflow_flag = 1;
        }
    }
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        if (table_state[i] == 1) {
            output[out++] = table_values[i];
        }
    }
    *output_count = out;
}

void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_cuda(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream4_fixed_capacity_dedup_launch");
    if (capacity == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("stream4 fixed-capacity table capacity must be greater than zero");
    }
    stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(
        input,
        output,
        output_count,
        input_count,
        threshold,
        capacity,
        table_keys,
        table_values,
        table_state,
        overflow_flag);
}

} // namespace beam

#include "stream3.hpp"

#include "config.hpp"
#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

namespace beam {

__global__ void stream3_pack_threshold_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t candidates_per_slot = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < stream3_batch_candidates; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t local_i = i % candidates_per_slot;
        const std::uint32_t parent_local = local_i / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
        if (parent_local >= b_micro) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t score_key = score_ring[i];
        if (score_key > current_threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        compact_key[out] = hash_ring[i];
        compact_val[out] = (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(score_key) << 32) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i);
        ++out;
    }
    *compact_count = out;
}

void stream3_pack_threshold_cuda(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    const std::uint64_t*,
    const std::uint32_t*,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream3_threshold_compact_launch");
    const dim3 block(1);
    const dim3 grid(1);
    stream3_pack_threshold_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        score_ring,
        hash_ring,
        compact_key,
        compact_val,
        compact_count,
        current_threshold,
        b_micro,
        stream3_batch_candidates);
}

} // namespace beam

#include "stream4.hpp"

#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <stdexcept>

namespace beam {

__device__ bool hash_equal_device(Hash128 a, Hash128 b) {
    return a.lo == b.lo && a.hi == b.hi;
}

__device__ bool candidate_better_device(CandidateMeta a, CandidateMeta b) {
    if (a.score_key != b.score_key) {
        return a.score_key < b.score_key;
    }
    if (a.parent_idx != b.parent_idx) {
        return a.parent_idx < b.parent_idx;
    }
    return a.route_packed < b.route_packed;
}

__device__ std::uint32_t stream4_slot_device(Hash128 hash, std::uint32_t capacity) {
    const std::uint64_t mixed = hash.hi ^ (hash.lo * 11400714819323198485ull);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed % capacity);
}

__global__ void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        table_state[i] = 0;
    }
    *output_count = 0;
    *overflow_flag = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < input_count; ++i) {
        const CandidateMeta candidate = input[i];
        if (candidate.score_key > threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t start = stream4_slot_device(candidate.hash, capacity);
        bool inserted = false;
        for (std::uint32_t probe = 0; probe < capacity; ++probe) {
            const std::uint32_t slot = (start + probe) % capacity;
            const std::uint32_t state = table_state[slot];
            if (state == 0) {
                table_keys[slot] = candidate.hash;
                table_values[slot] = candidate;
                table_state[slot] = 1;
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
            if (hash_equal_device(table_keys[slot], candidate.hash)) {
                if (candidate_better_device(candidate, table_values[slot])) {
                    table_values[slot] = candidate;
                }
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!inserted) {
            *overflow_flag = 1;
        }
    }
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        if (table_state[i] == 1) {
            output[out++] = table_values[i];
        }
    }
    *output_count = out;
}

void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_cuda(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream4_fixed_capacity_dedup_launch");
    if (capacity == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("stream4 fixed-capacity table capacity must be greater than zero");
    }
    stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(
        input,
        output,
        output_count,
        input_count,
        threshold,
        capacity,
        table_keys,
        table_values,
        table_state,
        overflow_flag);
}

} // namespace beam

[249] assistant: OOM из-за того, что запускался не финальный CUDA-пайплайн, а текущий PyTorch baseline.

При beam `2**22` получается:

- frontier: `4,194,304` states
- кандидатов на шаг: `4,194,304 * 24 = 100,663,296`

PyTorch baseline материализует большие временные тензоры: scores, indices, parent ids, gather/topk/sort buffers. Они одновременно висят в памяти, плюс PyTorch allocator кэширует память. В логе перед падением reserved memory дошла до `23.89 GB`, а RTX 3070 имеет `8 GB`.

По целевой архитектуре так быть не должно: Stream1 пишет только `score_key`, Stream2 только `Hash128`, Stream3/4 режут и дедупят потоково, full next frontier создается только в финале. Поэтому проблема не в идее архитектуры, а в том, что production CUDA runner еще не заменил PyTorch baseline.

[249] assistant: OOM из-за того, что запускался не финальный CUDA-пайплайн, а текущий PyTorch baseline.

При beam `2**22` получается:

- frontier: `4,194,304` states
- кандидатов на шаг: `4,194,304 * 24 = 100,663,296`

PyTorch baseline материализует большие временные тензоры: scores, indices, parent ids, gather/topk/sort buffers. Они одновременно висят в памяти, плюс PyTorch allocator кэширует память. В логе перед падением reserved memory дошла до `23.89 GB`, а RTX 3070 имеет `8 GB`.

По целевой архитектуре так быть не должно: Stream1 пишет только `score_key`, Stream2 только `Hash128`, Stream3/4 режут и дедупят потоково, full next frontier создается только в финале. Поэтому проблема не в идее архитектуры, а в том, что production CUDA runner еще не заменил PyTorch baseline.

ОСНОВНЫЕ ПРИНЦИПЫ:

СУЩНОСТЬ:

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

#include "config.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace beam {

std::uint64_t round_up(std::uint64_t value, std::uint64_t alignment) {
    if (alignment == 0) {
        return value;
    }
    const std::uint64_t remainder = value % alignment;
    return remainder == 0 ? value : value + alignment - remainder;
}

DerivedConfig derive_config(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    DerivedConfig derived;
    derived.ring_slot_count = config.stream3_batch_candidates / (config.b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT));
    derived.beam_width_alignment =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.shard_count) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.stream4_batch_candidates_per_shard_unit);
    derived.global_beam_width_effective =
        std::min(round_up(config.user_global_beam_width, derived.beam_width_alignment),
                 config.global_beam_width_max_safe);
    return derived;
}

std::uint32_t q_to_score_key(float q) {
    const float clamped = std::min(std::max(q, 0.0f), SCORE_MAX_Q);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::lround(clamped * static_cast<float>(SCORE_SCALE)));
}

} // namespace beam

#include "config.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace beam {

std::uint64_t round_up(std::uint64_t value, std::uint64_t alignment) {
    if (alignment == 0) {
        return value;
    }
    const std::uint64_t remainder = value % alignment;
    return remainder == 0 ? value : value + alignment - remainder;
}

DerivedConfig derive_config(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    DerivedConfig derived;
    derived.ring_slot_count = config.stream3_batch_candidates / (config.b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT));
    derived.beam_width_alignment =
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.shard_count) *
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.stream4_batch_candidates_per_shard_unit);
    derived.global_beam_width_effective =
        std::min(round_up(config.user_global_beam_width, derived.beam_width_alignment),
                 config.global_beam_width_max_safe);
    return derived;
}

std::uint32_t q_to_score_key(float q) {
    const float clamped = std::min(std::max(q, 0.0f), SCORE_MAX_Q);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::lround(clamped * static_cast<float>(SCORE_SCALE)));
}

} // namespace beam

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.

## Architecture Source

- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.

- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

    cudaEventCreate(&start);
    cudaEventCreate(&stop);
    for (auto& stream : streams) {
        cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking);
    }
    cudaEventRecord(start, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        dispatcher_spin_kernel<<<1, 256, 0, streams[i]>>>(spin_iterations, i + 1, sink + i * 256);

    for (auto stream : streams) {

    cudaEventRecord(stop, nullptr);
    cudaEventSynchronize(stop);
    float elapsed = 0.0f;

    for (auto stream : streams) {

    }
    cudaEventDestroy(start);

DispatcherOverlapResult dispatcher_overlap_smoke_cuda(std::uint32_t spin_iterations) {

    cudaMalloc(&sink, 5 * 256 * sizeof(std::uint32_t));
    cudaEventCreate(&start);
    cudaEventCreate(&stop);
    for (auto& stream : streams) {
        cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking);
    }
    cudaEventRecord(start, nullptr);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        dispatcher_spin_kernel<<<1, 256, 0, streams[i]>>>(spin_iterations, i + 1, sink + i * 256);

    for (auto stream : streams) {
        cudaStreamSynchronize(stream);
    }
    cudaEventRecord(stop, nullptr);
    cudaEventSynchronize(stop);
    float elapsed = 0.0f;
    cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsed, start, stop);
    for (auto stream : streams) {
        cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
    }
    cudaEventDestroy(start);
    cudaEventDestroy(stop);
    cudaFree(sink);
    return DispatcherOverlapResult{elapsed, elapsed * 5.0f};

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

void check_cuda(cudaError_t status, const char* op) {

#include "stream3.hpp"

#include "config.hpp"
#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

namespace beam {

__global__ void stream3_pack_threshold_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t candidates_per_slot = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < stream3_batch_candidates; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t local_i = i % candidates_per_slot;
        const std::uint32_t parent_local = local_i / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
        if (parent_local >= b_micro) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t score_key = score_ring[i];
        if (score_key > current_threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        compact_key[out] = hash_ring[i];
        compact_val[out] = (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(score_key) << 32) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i);
        ++out;
    }
    *compact_count = out;
}

void stream3_pack_threshold_cuda(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    const std::uint64_t*,
    const std::uint32_t*,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream3_threshold_compact_launch");
    const dim3 block(1);
    const dim3 grid(1);
    stream3_pack_threshold_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        score_ring,
        hash_ring,
        compact_key,
        compact_val,
        compact_count,
        current_threshold,
        b_micro,
        stream3_batch_candidates);
}

} // namespace beam

#include "stream3.hpp"

#include "config.hpp"
#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

namespace beam {

__global__ void stream3_pack_threshold_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t candidates_per_slot = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < stream3_batch_candidates; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t local_i = i % candidates_per_slot;
        const std::uint32_t parent_local = local_i / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
        if (parent_local >= b_micro) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t score_key = score_ring[i];
        if (score_key > current_threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        compact_key[out] = hash_ring[i];
        compact_val[out] = (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(score_key) << 32) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i);
        ++out;
    }
    *compact_count = out;
}

void stream3_pack_threshold_cuda(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    const std::uint64_t*,
    const std::uint32_t*,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream3_threshold_compact_launch");
    const dim3 block(1);
    const dim3 grid(1);
    stream3_pack_threshold_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        score_ring,
        hash_ring,
        compact_key,
        compact_val,
        compact_count,
        current_threshold,
        b_micro,
        stream3_batch_candidates);
}

} // namespace beam

+    const StaticMemoryPlan& plan,
+    StaticDeviceMemory& memory,
+    CudaGraphJobTemplates& graphs,
+    DispatcherStreams& streams,
+    std::uint64_t frontier_size) {
+    NvtxRange range("Dispatcher_depth_cuda_graphs");
+    const std::uint32_t ring_slot_job_count = plan.config.ring_count * plan.derived.ring_slot_count;
+    if (graphs.ring_slot_execs.size() != ring_slot_job_count ||
+        graphs.stream3_ring_execs.size() != plan.config.ring_count ||
+        graphs.stream4_shard_execs.size() != plan.config.shard_count) {
+        throw std::invalid_argument("depth dispatcher graph template counts do not match static memory plan");
+    }
+
+    DepthDispatchState state;
+    state.frontier_size = frontier_size;
+    while (state.frontier_cursor < frontier_size) {
+        const std::uint64_t remaining = frontier_size - state.frontier_cursor;
+        const std::uint32_t needed_jobs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
+            (remaining + plan.config.b_micro - 1ULL) / plan.config.b_micro);
+        const std::uint32_t jobs_this_wave = std::min(ring_slot_job_count, needed_jobs);
+
+        for (std::uint32_t job = 0; job < jobs_this_wave; ++job) {
+            const std::uint64_t parent_base_value = state.frontier_cursor;
+            const std::uint64_t remaining_for_job = frontier_size - state.frontier_cursor;
+            const std::uint32_t count_value = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(
+                std::min<std::uint64_t>(plan.config.b_micro, remaining_for_job));
+            check_cuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(
+                memory.streams.parent_base + job,
+                &parent_base_value,
+                sizeof(parent_base_value),
+                cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                streams.stream1), "cudaMemcpyAsync parent_base");
+            check_cuda(cudaMemcpyAsync(
+                memory.streams.count + job,
+                &count_value,
+                sizeof(count_value),
+                cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                streams.stream1), "cudaMemcpyAsync count");
+            state.frontier_cursor += count_value;
+        }
+        check_cuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams.stream1), "cudaStreamSynchronize parameter writes");
+
+        for (std::uint32_t job = 0; job < jobs_this_wave; ++job) {
+            check_cuda(cudaGraphLaunch(graphs.ring_slot_execs[job], streams.stream1), "cudaGraphLaunch ring_slot");
+            ++state.ring_slot_jobs_launched;
+        }
+        check_cuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams.stream1), "cudaStreamSynchronize ring_slot wave");
+
+        for (std::uint32_t ring = 0; ring < plan.config.ring_count; ++ring) {
+            check_cuda(cudaGraphLaunch(graphs.stream3_ring_execs[ring], streams.stream3), "cudaGraphLaunch stream3");
+            ++state.stream3_jobs_launched;
+        }
+        check_cuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams.stream3), "cudaStreamSynchronize stream3");
+

+            check_cuda(cudaGraphLaunch(graphs.stream4_shard_execs[shard], streams.stream4), "cudaGraphLaunch stream4");
+            ++state.stream4_jobs_launched;
+        }
+        check_cuda(cudaStreamSynchronize(streams.stream4), "cudaStreamSynchronize stream4");

+    return state;

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

#include "stream3.hpp"

#include "config.hpp"
#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

namespace beam {

__global__ void stream3_pack_threshold_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t candidates_per_slot = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < stream3_batch_candidates; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t local_i = i % candidates_per_slot;
        const std::uint32_t parent_local = local_i / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
        if (parent_local >= b_micro) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t score_key = score_ring[i];
        if (score_key > current_threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        compact_key[out] = hash_ring[i];
        compact_val[out] = (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(score_key) << 32) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i);
        ++out;
    }
    *compact_count = out;
}

void stream3_pack_threshold_cuda(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    const std::uint64_t*,
    const std::uint32_t*,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream3_threshold_compact_launch");
    const dim3 block(1);
    const dim3 grid(1);
    stream3_pack_threshold_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        score_ring,
        hash_ring,
        compact_key,
        compact_val,
        compact_count,
        current_threshold,
        b_micro,
        stream3_batch_candidates);
}

} // namespace beam

#include "stream4.hpp"

#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <stdexcept>

namespace beam {

__device__ bool hash_equal_device(Hash128 a, Hash128 b) {
    return a.lo == b.lo && a.hi == b.hi;
}

__device__ bool candidate_better_device(CandidateMeta a, CandidateMeta b) {
    if (a.score_key != b.score_key) {
        return a.score_key < b.score_key;
    }
    if (a.parent_idx != b.parent_idx) {
        return a.parent_idx < b.parent_idx;
    }
    return a.route_packed < b.route_packed;
}

__device__ std::uint32_t stream4_slot_device(Hash128 hash, std::uint32_t capacity) {
    const std::uint64_t mixed = hash.hi ^ (hash.lo * 11400714819323198485ull);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed % capacity);
}

__global__ void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        table_state[i] = 0;
    }
    *output_count = 0;
    *overflow_flag = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < input_count; ++i) {
        const CandidateMeta candidate = input[i];
        if (candidate.score_key > threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t start = stream4_slot_device(candidate.hash, capacity);
        bool inserted = false;
        for (std::uint32_t probe = 0; probe < capacity; ++probe) {
            const std::uint32_t slot = (start + probe) % capacity;
            const std::uint32_t state = table_state[slot];
            if (state == 0) {
                table_keys[slot] = candidate.hash;
                table_values[slot] = candidate;
                table_state[slot] = 1;
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
            if (hash_equal_device(table_keys[slot], candidate.hash)) {
                if (candidate_better_device(candidate, table_values[slot])) {
                    table_values[slot] = candidate;
                }
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!inserted) {
            *overflow_flag = 1;
        }
    }
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        if (table_state[i] == 1) {
            output[out++] = table_values[i];
        }
    }
    *output_count = out;
}

void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_cuda(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream4_fixed_capacity_dedup_launch");
    if (capacity == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("stream4 fixed-capacity table capacity must be greater than zero");
    }
    stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(
        input,
        output,
        output_count,
        input_count,
        threshold,
        capacity,
        table_keys,
        table_values,
        table_state,
        overflow_flag);
}

} // namespace beam

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

#include "stream3.hpp"

#include "config.hpp"
#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

namespace beam {

__global__ void stream3_pack_threshold_kernel(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    const std::uint32_t candidates_per_slot = b_micro * static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < stream3_batch_candidates; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t local_i = i % candidates_per_slot;
        const std::uint32_t parent_local = local_i / static_cast<std::uint32_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
        if (parent_local >= b_micro) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t score_key = score_ring[i];
        if (score_key > current_threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        compact_key[out] = hash_ring[i];
        compact_val[out] = (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(score_key) << 32) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(i);
        ++out;
    }
    *compact_count = out;
}

void stream3_pack_threshold_cuda(
    const std::uint32_t* score_ring,
    const Hash128* hash_ring,
    const std::uint64_t*,
    const std::uint32_t*,
    Hash128* compact_key,
    std::uint64_t* compact_val,
    std::uint32_t* compact_count,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint32_t b_micro,
    std::uint32_t stream3_batch_candidates,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream3_threshold_compact_launch");
    const dim3 block(1);
    const dim3 grid(1);
    stream3_pack_threshold_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        score_ring,
        hash_ring,
        compact_key,
        compact_val,
        compact_count,
        current_threshold,
        b_micro,
        stream3_batch_candidates);
}

} // namespace beam

#include "stream4.hpp"

#include "nvtx_ranges.hpp"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include <stdexcept>

namespace beam {

__device__ bool hash_equal_device(Hash128 a, Hash128 b) {
    return a.lo == b.lo && a.hi == b.hi;
}

__device__ bool candidate_better_device(CandidateMeta a, CandidateMeta b) {
    if (a.score_key != b.score_key) {
        return a.score_key < b.score_key;
    }
    if (a.parent_idx != b.parent_idx) {
        return a.parent_idx < b.parent_idx;
    }
    return a.route_packed < b.route_packed;
}

__device__ std::uint32_t stream4_slot_device(Hash128 hash, std::uint32_t capacity) {
    const std::uint64_t mixed = hash.hi ^ (hash.lo * 11400714819323198485ull);
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed % capacity);
}

__global__ void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag) {
    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
        return;
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        table_state[i] = 0;
    }
    *output_count = 0;
    *overflow_flag = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < input_count; ++i) {
        const CandidateMeta candidate = input[i];
        if (candidate.score_key > threshold) {
            continue;
        }
        const std::uint32_t start = stream4_slot_device(candidate.hash, capacity);
        bool inserted = false;
        for (std::uint32_t probe = 0; probe < capacity; ++probe) {
            const std::uint32_t slot = (start + probe) % capacity;
            const std::uint32_t state = table_state[slot];
            if (state == 0) {
                table_keys[slot] = candidate.hash;
                table_values[slot] = candidate;
                table_state[slot] = 1;
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
            if (hash_equal_device(table_keys[slot], candidate.hash)) {
                if (candidate_better_device(candidate, table_values[slot])) {
                    table_values[slot] = candidate;
                }
                inserted = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!inserted) {
            *overflow_flag = 1;
        }
    }
    std::uint32_t out = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
        if (table_state[i] == 1) {
            output[out++] = table_values[i];
        }
    }
    *output_count = out;
}

void stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_cuda(
    const CandidateMeta* input,
    CandidateMeta* output,
    std::uint32_t* output_count,
    std::uint32_t input_count,
    std::uint32_t threshold,
    std::uint32_t capacity,
    Hash128* table_keys,
    CandidateMeta* table_values,
    std::uint32_t* table_state,
    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag,
    cudaStream_t stream) {
    NvtxRange range("Stream4_fixed_capacity_dedup_launch");
    if (capacity == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("stream4 fixed-capacity table capacity must be greater than zero");
    }
    stream4_threshold_dedup_fixed_capacity_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(
        input,
        output,
        output_count,
        input_count,
        threshold,
        capacity,
        table_keys,
        table_values,
        table_state,
        overflow_flag);
}

} // namespace beam

void require(bool condition, const char* message) {
    if (!condition) {
        throw std::runtime_error(message);

Generator identity_generator() {
    Generator generator{};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++i) {
        generator[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
    }
    return generator;
}

Generator swap01_generator() {
    Generator generator = identity_generator();
    generator[0] = 1;
    generator[1] = 0;
    return generator;
}

int main() {
    std::filesystem::create_directories("test_results");

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < STATE_LEN; ++i) {

    generators[1] = swap01_generator();
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> flat_generators(MOVE_COUNT * STATE_STORAGE_LEN);
    for (std::size_t move = 0; move < MOVE_COUNT; ++move) {
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
            flat_generators[move * STATE_STORAGE_LEN + p] = generators[move][p];

__device__ bool hash_less_or_equal_device(Hash128 a, Hash128 b) {

    return a.lo <= b.lo;

#include "hash.hpp"

#include <random>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace beam {

bool operator==(const Hash128& a, const Hash128& b) {
    return a.lo == b.lo && a.hi == b.hi;
}

bool hash_less(const Hash128& a, const Hash128& b) {
    if (a.hi != b.hi) {
        return a.hi < b.hi;
    }
    return a.lo < b.lo;
}

std::uint32_t pack_route(std::uint16_t source_rank, std::uint8_t owner, std::uint8_t move) {
    return (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(source_rank) << 16) |
           (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(owner) << 8) |
           static_cast<std::uint32_t>(move);
}

std::uint16_t unpack_source_rank(std::uint32_t route_packed) {
    return static_cast<std::uint16_t>(route_packed >> 16);
}

std::uint8_t unpack_owner(std::uint32_t route_packed) {
    return static_cast<std::uint8_t>((route_packed >> 8) & 0xff);
}

std::uint8_t unpack_move(std::uint32_t route_packed) {
    return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(route_packed & 0xff);
}

Hash128 hash_state(const State128& state, const ZobristTable& zobrist) {
    Hash128 hash{0, 0};
    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        const Hash128 h = zobrist[p][state.v[p]];
        hash.lo ^= h.lo;
        hash.hi ^= h.hi;
    }
    return hash;
}

ZobristTable make_deterministic_zobrist(std::uint64_t seed) {
    ZobristTable table{};
    std::mt19937_64 rng(seed);
    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < STATE_LEN; ++p) {
        for (std::size_t v = 0; v < STATE_VALUE_PAD; ++v) {
            table[p][v] = Hash128{rng(), rng()};
        }
    }
    for (std::size_t p = STATE_LEN; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        for (std::size_t v = 0; v < STATE_VALUE_PAD; ++v) {
            table[p][v] = Hash128{0, 0};
        }
    }
    return table;
}

std::uint8_t owner_from_hash128(const Hash128& hash, std::uint32_t world_size) {
    if (world_size == 0 || world_size > 256) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("world_size must be in [1, 256]");
    }
    return static_cast<std::uint8_t>((hash.hi ^ hash.lo) % world_size);
}

std::uint32_t shard_from_hash128(const Hash128& hash, std::uint32_t shard_count) {
    if (shard_count == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("shard_count must be positive");
    }
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>((hash.hi ^ (hash.lo >> 32)) % shard_count);
}

} // namespace beam

Stream3SplitResult stream3_threshold_dedup_split(
    const std::vector<Stream3CandidateInput>& input,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint16_t local_rank,
    std::uint32_t world_size) {
    struct Packed {
        Hash128 hash;
        std::uint64_t val;
        std::uint64_t parent_idx;
        std::uint8_t move;
    };

    std::vector<Packed> compacted;
    compacted.reserve(input.size());
    for (const auto& item : input) {
        if (item.score_key <= current_threshold) {
            compacted.push_back(Packed{item.hash, pack_stream3_val(item.score_key, item.payload_id), item.parent_idx, item.move});
        }
    }

    std::sort(compacted.begin(), compacted.end(), [](const Packed& a, const Packed& b) {
        if (!hash_less(a.hash, b.hash) && !(a.hash == b.hash)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(a.hash == b.hash)) {
            return true;
        }
        return a.val < b.val;
    });

            const std::uint32_t score_key = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(item.val >> 32);
            const std::uint8_t owner = owner_from_hash128(item.hash, world_size);
            unique.push_back(CandidateMeta{item.hash, item.parent_idx, score_key, pack_route(local_rank, owner, item.move)});
        }
    }

    Stream3SplitResult result;
    result.send_count.assign(world_size, 0);
    result.send_offset.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(world_size) + 1, 0);
    for (const auto& meta : unique) {
        const auto owner = unpack_owner(meta.route_packed);
        if (owner == local_rank) {
            result.local_pending.push_back(meta);
        } else {
            ++result.send_count[owner];
        }
    }
    for (std::uint32_t peer = 0; peer < world_size; ++peer) {
        result.send_offset[peer + 1] = result.send_offset[peer] + result.send_count[peer];
    }
    result.remote_send.resize(result.send_offset[world_size]);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> cursor = result.send_offset;
    for (const auto& meta : unique) {
        const auto owner = unpack_owner(meta.route_packed);
        if (owner != local_rank) {
            result.remote_send[cursor[owner]++] = meta;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

} // namespace beam

__global__ void stream5_single_rank_exchange_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* remote_send_buffer,

#include "hash.hpp"

#include <random>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace beam {

bool operator==(const Hash128& a, const Hash128& b) {
    return a.lo == b.lo && a.hi == b.hi;
}

bool hash_less(const Hash128& a, const Hash128& b) {
    if (a.hi != b.hi) {
        return a.hi < b.hi;
    }
    return a.lo < b.lo;
}

std::uint32_t pack_route(std::uint16_t source_rank, std::uint8_t owner, std::uint8_t move) {
    return (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(source_rank) << 16) |
           (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(owner) << 8) |
           static_cast<std::uint32_t>(move);
}

std::uint16_t unpack_source_rank(std::uint32_t route_packed) {
    return static_cast<std::uint16_t>(route_packed >> 16);
}

std::uint8_t unpack_owner(std::uint32_t route_packed) {
    return static_cast<std::uint8_t>((route_packed >> 8) & 0xff);
}

std::uint8_t unpack_move(std::uint32_t route_packed) {
    return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(route_packed & 0xff);
}

Hash128 hash_state(const State128& state, const ZobristTable& zobrist) {
    Hash128 hash{0, 0};
    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        const Hash128 h = zobrist[p][state.v[p]];
        hash.lo ^= h.lo;
        hash.hi ^= h.hi;
    }
    return hash;
}

ZobristTable make_deterministic_zobrist(std::uint64_t seed) {
    ZobristTable table{};
    std::mt19937_64 rng(seed);
    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < STATE_LEN; ++p) {
        for (std::size_t v = 0; v < STATE_VALUE_PAD; ++v) {
            table[p][v] = Hash128{rng(), rng()};
        }
    }
    for (std::size_t p = STATE_LEN; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        for (std::size_t v = 0; v < STATE_VALUE_PAD; ++v) {
            table[p][v] = Hash128{0, 0};
        }
    }
    return table;
}

std::uint8_t owner_from_hash128(const Hash128& hash, std::uint32_t world_size) {
    if (world_size == 0 || world_size > 256) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("world_size must be in [1, 256]");
    }
    return static_cast<std::uint8_t>((hash.hi ^ hash.lo) % world_size);
}

std::uint32_t shard_from_hash128(const Hash128& hash, std::uint32_t shard_count) {
    if (shard_count == 0) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("shard_count must be positive");
    }
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>((hash.hi ^ (hash.lo >> 32)) % shard_count);
}

} // namespace beam

#include "stream3.hpp"

#include "hash.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace beam {

std::uint64_t pack_stream3_val(std::uint32_t score_key, std::uint32_t payload_id) {
    return (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(score_key) << 32) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(payload_id);
}

Stream3SplitResult stream3_threshold_dedup_split(
    const std::vector<Stream3CandidateInput>& input,
    std::uint32_t current_threshold,
    std::uint16_t local_rank,
    std::uint32_t world_size) {
    struct Packed {
        Hash128 hash;
        std::uint64_t val;
        std::uint64_t parent_idx;
        std::uint8_t move;
    };

    std::vector<Packed> compacted;
    compacted.reserve(input.size());
    for (const auto& item : input) {
        if (item.score_key <= current_threshold) {
            compacted.push_back(Packed{item.hash, pack_stream3_val(item.score_key, item.payload_id), item.parent_idx, item.move});
        }
    }

    std::sort(compacted.begin(), compacted.end(), [](const Packed& a, const Packed& b) {
        if (!hash_less(a.hash, b.hash) && !(a.hash == b.hash)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(a.hash == b.hash)) {
            return true;
        }
        return a.val < b.val;
    });

    std::vector<CandidateMeta> unique;
    for (const auto& item : compacted) {
        if (unique.empty() || !(unique.back().hash == item.hash)) {
            const std::uint32_t score_key = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(item.val >> 32);
            const std::uint8_t owner = owner_from_hash128(item.hash, world_size);
            unique.push_back(CandidateMeta{item.hash, item.parent_idx, score_key, pack_route(local_rank, owner, item.move)});
        }
    }

    Stream3SplitResult result;
    result.send_count.assign(world_size, 0);
    result.send_offset.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(world_size) + 1, 0);
    for (const auto& meta : unique) {
        const auto owner = unpack_owner(meta.route_packed);
        if (owner == local_rank) {
            result.local_pending.push_back(meta);
        } else {
            ++result.send_count[owner];
        }
    }
    for (std::uint32_t peer = 0; peer < world_size; ++peer) {
        result.send_offset[peer + 1] = result.send_offset[peer] + result.send_count[peer];
    }
    result.remote_send.resize(result.send_offset[world_size]);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> cursor = result.send_offset;
    for (const auto& meta : unique) {
        const auto owner = unpack_owner(meta.route_packed);
        if (owner != local_rank) {
            result.remote_send[cursor[owner]++] = meta;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

} // namespace beam

__global__ void stream5_single_rank_exchange_kernel(
    const CandidateMeta* remote_send_buffer,
    const std::uint32_t* send_count,
    const std::uint32_t* send_offset,
    CandidateMeta* remote_recv_buffer,
    std::uint32_t* recv_count,

+__global__ void stream4_shard_job_kernel(
+    CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
+    std::uint32_t* clean_count,
+    std::uint32_t* dirty_count,
+    std::uint32_t* processing_flag,
+    std::uint32_t threshold,
+    std::uint32_t capacity,
+    Hash128* table_keys,
+    CandidateMeta* table_values,
+    std::uint32_t* table_state,
+    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag) {
+    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::uint32_t input_count = *clean_count + *dirty_count;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
+        table_state[i] = 0;
+    }
+    *overflow_flag = 0;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < input_count; ++i) {
+        const CandidateMeta candidate = survivor_shard[i];
+        if (candidate.score_key > threshold) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        const std::uint32_t start = stream4_slot_device(candidate.hash, capacity);
+        bool inserted = false;
+        for (std::uint32_t probe = 0; probe < capacity; ++probe) {
+            const std::uint32_t slot = (start + probe) % capacity;
+            const std::uint32_t state = table_state[slot];
+            if (state == 0) {
+                table_keys[slot] = candidate.hash;
+                table_values[slot] = candidate;
+                table_state[slot] = 1;
+                inserted = true;
+                break;
+            }
+            if (hash_equal_device(table_keys[slot], candidate.hash)) {
+                if (candidate_better_device(candidate, table_values[slot])) {
+                    table_values[slot] = candidate;
+                }
+                inserted = true;
+                break;
+            }
+        }
+        if (!inserted) {
+            *overflow_flag = 1;
+        }
+    }
+    std::uint32_t out = 0;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
+        if (table_state[i] == 1) {
+            survivor_shard[out++] = table_values[i];
+        }
+    }
+    *clean_count = out;
+    *dirty_count = 0;
+    *processing_flag = 0;
+}
+

+# Stream3 Restore Owner Split 2026-05-22
+

+- Owner rule: `(hash.hi ^ hash.lo) % WORLD_SIZE`.
+- Route rule: `(LOCAL_RANK << 16) | (owner << 8) | move`.

+__global__ void stream4_shard_job_kernel(
+    CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
+    std::uint32_t* clean_count,
+    std::uint32_t* dirty_count,
+    std::uint32_t* processing_flag,
+    std::uint32_t threshold,
+    std::uint32_t capacity,
+    Hash128* table_keys,
+    CandidateMeta* table_values,
+    std::uint32_t* table_state,
+    std::uint32_t* overflow_flag) {
+    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::uint32_t input_count = *clean_count + *dirty_count;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
+        table_state[i] = 0;
+    }
+    *overflow_flag = 0;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < input_count; ++i) {
+        const CandidateMeta candidate = survivor_shard[i];
+        if (candidate.score_key > threshold) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        const std::uint32_t start = stream4_slot_device(candidate.hash, capacity);
+        bool inserted = false;
+        for (std::uint32_t probe = 0; probe < capacity; ++probe) {
+            const std::uint32_t slot = (start + probe) % capacity;
+            const std::uint32_t state = table_state[slot];
+            if (state == 0) {
+                table_keys[slot] = candidate.hash;
+                table_values[slot] = candidate;
+                table_state[slot] = 1;
+                inserted = true;
+                break;
+            }
+            if (hash_equal_device(table_keys[slot], candidate.hash)) {
+                if (candidate_better_device(candidate, table_values[slot])) {
+                    table_values[slot] = candidate;
+                }
+                inserted = true;
+                break;
+            }
+        }
+        if (!inserted) {
+            *overflow_flag = 1;
+        }
+    }
+    std::uint32_t out = 0;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < capacity; ++i) {
+        if (table_state[i] == 1) {
+            survivor_shard[out++] = table_values[i];
+        }
+    }
+    *clean_count = out;
+    *dirty_count = 0;
+    *processing_flag = 0;
+}
+

+__global__ void stream3_collect_local_pending_kernel(
+    const CandidateMeta* local_pending_buffer,
+    const std::uint32_t* local_pending_count,
+    CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
+    std::uint32_t* clean_count,
+    std::uint32_t* dirty_count,
+    const std::uint32_t* processing_flag,
+    CandidateMeta* global_spill_buffer,
+    std::uint32_t* global_spill_count,
+    std::uint32_t shard_count,
+    std::uint32_t stream4_batch_candidates,
+    std::uint32_t global_spill_capacity) {
+    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::uint32_t shard_capacity = 2U * stream4_batch_candidates;
+    std::uint32_t spill_count = *global_spill_count;
+    const std::uint32_t count = *local_pending_count;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const CandidateMeta candidate = local_pending_buffer[i];
+        const std::uint32_t shard = shard_from_hash128_stream3_device(candidate.hash, shard_count);
+        const std::uint32_t clean = clean_count[shard];
+        const std::uint32_t dirty = dirty_count[shard];
+        if (processing_flag[shard] == 0 && clean + dirty < shard_capacity) {
+            survivor_shard[static_cast<std::uint64_t>(shard) * shard_capacity + clean + dirty] = candidate;
+            dirty_count[shard] = dirty + 1U;
+        } else if (spill_count < global_spill_capacity) {
+            global_spill_buffer[spill_count++] = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+    *global_spill_count = spill_count;
+}

+# Stream3 Local Pending Collector 2026-05-22
+
+## Scope
+- Added `stream3_collect_local_pending_cuda`.
+- Source: `local_pending_buffer[0 : local_pending_count]`.
+- Destination when shard is free and has capacity: `survivor_shard[shard][clean_count + dirty_count]`.
+- Destination when shard is busy or full: `global_spill_buffer[global_spill_count++]`.
+- Shard rule: `(hash.hi ^ (hash.lo >> 32)) % SHARD_COUNT`.
+- Writer rule: one Stream 3 collector kernel writes shard dirty regions; no Stream 4 writer conflict; no atomics.
+
+## Fixed Memory Additions
+- `global_spill_count : uint32_t`
+
+## Dispatcher Wiring
+- Stream 3 graph template order:
+  1. threshold/scan/compact/sort/dedup
+  2. restore `CandidateMeta`, compute owner, split local/remote
+  3. collect local pending candidates into shard dirty regions or global spill
+

+- Command: `docker compose run --rm beam-tests`
+- Result: 10/10 tests passed.
+- `stream3_cuda_tests` verifies shard dirty count update, survivor write location, zero spill for free shard, and spill count update for busy shard.
+- `static_memory_cuda_tests` verifies `global_spill_count` exists inside fixed `layout_streams`.

+__global__ void stream3_drain_global_spill_kernel(
+    CandidateMeta* global_spill_buffer,
+    std::uint32_t* global_spill_count,
+    CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
+    std::uint32_t* clean_count,
+    std::uint32_t* dirty_count,
+    const std::uint32_t* processing_flag,
+    std::uint32_t shard_count,
+    std::uint32_t stream4_batch_candidates) {
+    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::uint32_t shard_capacity = 2U * stream4_batch_candidates;
+    const std::uint32_t spill_count = *global_spill_count;
+    std::uint32_t remaining = 0;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < spill_count; ++i) {
+        const CandidateMeta candidate = global_spill_buffer[i];
+        const std::uint32_t shard = shard_from_hash128_stream3_device(candidate.hash, shard_count);
+        const std::uint32_t clean = clean_count[shard];
+        const std::uint32_t dirty = dirty_count[shard];
+        if (processing_flag[shard] == 0 && clean + dirty < shard_capacity) {
+            survivor_shard[static_cast<std::uint64_t>(shard) * shard_capacity + clean + dirty] = candidate;
+            dirty_count[shard] = dirty + 1U;
+        } else {
+            global_spill_buffer[remaining++] = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+    *global_spill_count = remaining;
+}
+
 } // namespace

+# Stream3 Local Pending Collector 2026-05-22
+
+## Scope
+- Added `stream3_collect_local_pending_cuda`.
+- Source: `local_pending_buffer[0 : local_pending_count]`.
+- Destination when shard is free and has capacity: `survivor_shard[shard][clean_count + dirty_count]`.
+- Destination when shard is busy or full: `global_spill_buffer[global_spill_count++]`.
+- Shard rule: `(hash.hi ^ (hash.lo >> 32)) % SHARD_COUNT`.
+- Writer rule: one Stream 3 collector kernel writes shard dirty regions; no Stream 4 writer conflict; no atomics.
+
+## Fixed Memory Additions
+- `global_spill_count : uint32_t`
+
+## Dispatcher Wiring
+- Stream 3 graph template order:
+  1. threshold/scan/compact/sort/dedup
+  2. restore `CandidateMeta`, compute owner, split local/remote
+  3. collect local pending candidates into shard dirty regions or global spill
+
+## Verification
+- Command: `docker compose run --rm beam-tests`
+- Result: 10/10 tests passed.
+- `stream3_cuda_tests` verifies shard dirty count update, survivor write location, zero spill for free shard, and spill count update for busy shard.
+- `static_memory_cuda_tests` verifies `global_spill_count` exists inside fixed `layout_streams`.
+
+## Guard Scans
+- Forbidden active terms scan over `cuda src tests CMakeLists.txt docker-compose.yml Dockerfile`: no matches for `smoke|fallback|dispatcher_overlap|dispatcher_pipeline|PyTorch|torch`.
+- Dispatcher allocation scan over `cuda/dispatcher.cu` and `cuda/dispatcher.hpp`: no matches for `cudaMalloc|cudaFree`.
+- Atomic scan over `cuda src tests`: only Stream 2 solved path uses atomics and `__threadfence_system`.
+
+## Remaining Work
+- Collector still needs global spill drain and remote receive drain integration.
+- Collector implementation is GPU-resident and no-atomic, but currently single-thread. Production optimization must replace collector loops with parallel scan/partition over owned shard regions.

    no CUB sort count dependency
    no top-k shard cap
    no semantic shard cap beyond fixed buffer capacity
    keep best CandidateMeta by score_key
    tie-break deterministic by parent_idx then route_packed

Output contract remains:
    survivor_shard[shard][0 : new_clean_count] = clean deduped survivors
    clean_count[shard] = new_clean_count
    dirty_count[shard] = 0
    processing_flag[shard] = false

This clarification changes implementation mechanics only.
Stream semantics remain threshold + dedup by Hash128 + best CandidateMeta.
```

+__global__ void stream3_drain_global_spill_kernel(
+    CandidateMeta* global_spill_buffer,
+    std::uint32_t* global_spill_count,
+    CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
+    std::uint32_t* clean_count,
+    std::uint32_t* dirty_count,
+    const std::uint32_t* processing_flag,
+    std::uint32_t shard_count,
+    std::uint32_t stream4_batch_candidates) {
+    if (blockIdx.x != 0 || threadIdx.x != 0) {
+        return;
+    }
+    const std::uint32_t shard_capacity = 2U * stream4_batch_candidates;
+    const std::uint32_t spill_count = *global_spill_count;
+    std::uint32_t remaining = 0;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < spill_count; ++i) {
+        const CandidateMeta candidate = global_spill_buffer[i];
+        const std::uint32_t shard = shard_from_hash128_stream3_device(candidate.hash, shard_count);
+        const std::uint32_t clean = clean_count[shard];
+        const std::uint32_t dirty = dirty_count[shard];
+        if (processing_flag[shard] == 0 && clean + dirty < shard_capacity) {
+            survivor_shard[static_cast<std::uint64_t>(shard) * shard_capacity + clean + dirty] = candidate;
+            dirty_count[shard] = dirty + 1U;
+        } else {
+            global_spill_buffer[remaining++] = candidate;
+        }
+    }
+    *global_spill_count = remaining;
+}
+
 } // namespace

+# Stream3 Global Spill Drain 2026-05-22
+
+## Scope
+- Added `stream3_drain_global_spill_cuda`.
+- Source: `global_spill_buffer[0 : global_spill_count]`.
+- Destination when shard is free and has capacity: `survivor_shard[shard][clean_count + dirty_count]`.

+1. Stream 3 threshold/scan/compact/sort/dedup.

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

+__global__ void stream3_drain_global_spill_kernel(
+    CandidateMeta* global_spill_buffer,
+    std::uint32_t* global_spill_count,
+    CandidateMeta* survivor_shard,
+    std::uint32_t* clean_count,
+    std::uint32_t* dirty_count,

+    const std::uint32_t spill_count = *global_spill_count;
+    std::uint32_t remaining = 0;
+    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < spill_count; ++i) {
+        const CandidateMeta candidate = global_spill_buffer[i];
+        const std::uint32_t shard = shard_from_hash128_stream3_device(candidate.hash, shard_count);

+            dirty_count[shard] = dirty + 1U;

+        }
+    }

+# Stream3 Global Spill Drain 2026-05-22
+
+## Scope
+- Added `stream3_drain_global_spill_cuda`.
+- Source: `global_spill_buffer[0 : global_spill_count]`.
+- Destination when shard is free and has capacity: `survivor_shard[shard][clean_count + dirty_count]`.
+- Remaining blocked candidates are compacted back into `global_spill_buffer[0 : new_global_spill_count]`.
+- Collector source order in Stream 3 graph template now starts with global spill drain before local pending collection.
+
+## Dispatcher Order
+1. Stream 3 threshold/scan/compact/sort/dedup.
+2. Stream 3 restore `CandidateMeta`, compute owner, split local/remote.
+3. Stream 3 drain global spill.
+4. Stream 3 collect local pending.
+
+## Verification
+- Command: `docker compose run --rm beam-tests`
+- Result: 10/10 tests passed.
+- `stream3_cuda_tests` verifies busy-shard spill creation, later global spill drain, dirty-count increment, and survivor write position.
+
+## Guard Scans
+- Forbidden active terms scan over `cuda src tests CMakeLists.txt docker-compose.yml Dockerfile`: no matches for `smoke|fallback|dispatcher_overlap|dispatcher_pipeline|PyTorch|torch`.
+- Dispatcher allocation scan over `cuda/dispatcher.cu` and `cuda/dispatcher.hpp`: no matches for `cudaMalloc|cudaFree`.
+- Atomic scan over `cuda src tests`: only Stream 2 solved path uses atomics and `__threadfence_system`.
+
+## Remaining Work
+- Remote receive collector remains incomplete.
+- Collector implementation is GPU-resident and no-atomic, but currently single-thread. Production optimization must replace collector loops with parallel scan/partition over owned shard regions.
*** End Patch

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current accepted clarification: Stream 4 may use fixed-capacity GPU hash-table dedup while preserving threshold plus Hash128 dedup semantics.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.
